title: Los Acuerdos de Paz
goal: Read how Nicaragua's 1990 elections, El Salvador's 1992 Chapultepec Accords, and Guatemala's 1996 Peace Accords each ended these wars through negotiation, not military victory -- and what those settlements left unresolved.
grammar: No sin antes: reconocer un paso previo necesario

items: Describe what happened in Nicaragua's February 1990 elections.
State when and where the Chapultepec Accords were signed.
State when Guatemala's Peace Accords were finally signed.
Explain the shared pattern across all three peace processes.
Use no sin antes to acknowledge a necessary prior step.
